notes.title: 1.2.0 Change and Website
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated collision checks.
[*] Reworked aiming to work with the new collision.
[*] Added a fail safe to respawn creative hunters still able to fall too far under the map.
[*] Default volume sliders start slightly quieter.
[*] Version number shows on the starting screen instead of in the credits section.
[*] [url=https://www.mothinteractive.com/]www.mothinteractive.com[/url] is now an official website!
[/list]
